status: Corrected account of generation settings. generation_metadata.json is the frozen packaging note and is not edited. This file does not invent values that were not logged.

tutor_decoding.verified: The historical Gemini tutor body in models.py sent system_instruction and contents only. It did not send generationConfig.
tutor_decoding.max_output_tokens: not set in the historical request
tutor_decoding.do_not_claim: Do not describe the historical tutor calls as temperature 0.

judges.name: gemini
judges.role: Labels on all 192 transcripts used for the headline abandonment rates. Same model family as the tutors. Not a human label.
judges.note: The original metadata said temperature 0. The request builder did not set temperature. A later edit that sets temperature applies only to new calls.

judges.name: gptoss
judges.role: Second judge used as a comparison. A different model family is not by itself a de-biased judge.
judges.note: The builder sets temperature 0. No saved request proves the historical call used that body. Raw text cannot be recovered from the parsed file.

human_ratings.role: Validation subset. Not ground truth for all 192 transcripts.
human_ratings.binary_column: consensus_holds_or_abandon stores abandonment as abandons and non-abandonment as holds. The token holds in that column is not the five-way stance holds.
human_ratings.selection: Exact historical sampling procedure was not saved. See README.

future_calls.output_budget: A live tutor run requires --max-output-tokens. There is no default cap, including no 400-token default.
future_calls.truncation: A finish reason of MAX_TOKENS, max_tokens, or length is saved as an incomplete response and is not a completed turn or a stance.
